failure_modes.recovery: Call myinvois_template_list to find a valid id.
failure_modes.when: the id does not name a template in your tenant

failure_modes.recovery: Fix the named line item field — money is integer CENTS, tax rates are basis points (600 = 6%).
failure_modes.when: a sent line_items_json is not a JSON array of valid line items

description: Edit a saved line-item preset. When line_items_json is included it is re-parsed and every item re-validated exactly as create does, so an edited template cannot drift into a shape myinvois_invoice_generate would reject. NEXT: myinvois_template_list to find the id.

expected_updated_at.description: Optional compare-and-set guard: the updated_at from a prior myinvois_template_list/read. Mismatch returns CONFLICT with the current value.

name: myinvois_template_update
